title: No transient-nuclear test matches after 17 March 1956

tellings.quote: uh the last time we saw a correspondence between a nuclear test and a uh transient was March 17th, 1956.

plain: Old sky photographs from the Palomar Observatory in California show brief flashes of light, called transients, and some of them line up in time with nuclear bomb tests. The last such match is said to fall on 17 March 1956. The researcher Steven Bruel gives the date without naming a source, and it matters because a link to nuclear tests would hint that the flashes were tied to events on Earth.
